tutorial.text: Two pillars this time. Blue means |1> (blocked), a mixed color means superposition. Grab the H-Gate one tile below you first, then the X-Gate ahead.
The H-Gate creates or undoes superposition. Use it to bring a pillar back to a pure state.
Nice, check the pillar's color. Only an exact |0> lets you through.
You've got the basics. Try the level select for the full puzzle set.
